provenance.authoring: Agent-authored finite scenarios and owner-preference labels, with explicit arithmetic, filtering and ordering rules; not labels supplied by actual owners or inferred by an evaluator model.
provenance.limits: Heldout denotes scenario families reserved from benchmark prompt and harness tuning, not unknown pretraining content. Identical-public ambiguous twins encode two possible owner preferences. Gold is authored synthetic intent, not independently observed world truth. Field-ID clarification is graded; free-form question quality is not. This version covers one unresolved field per ambiguous case.
